scientific_intent.scientific_task: Construct quantized color-similarity neighborhoods and resolve diagonal crossings using source local graph heuristics
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Float32RGB→clamped8-bitYUV; undirected8-neighbor threshold graph(Y48/U7/V6), then2×2 perimeter/diagonal decisions from color frequency, degree1 islands and capped degree2 curve scores. Equal-score ambiguous crossings retain both diagonals.
scientific_intent.discretization: Seven finite palette images,16×16,32×16,16×32,32×32;3328pixels total.256threads, fullblocks, two kernels/case; conditional source fixes established independently before GPU.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact all3328 temporary packed YUV/connectivity words and3328 final graph words/trial, actualRGB input echoes and560guardwords, exact9998input/parameterprefixwords. Independent explicit adjacency-list oracle and geometric walk invariant, source/corrected CPU-ASan probes, bothGPUrefs.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: 256..1024pixels/case; full256-threadblocks, local adaptive graph walks capped at image size. Kernel-component microstudy, not application-scale vectorization throughput.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Actual Float32input/colors, UInt32quantizedcolor/connectivity/output. Palette bin margin.0224036 exceeds conservative32epsF32*255 allowance.000972748, so permitted Float32/FMAassociation differences cannot alter selected bins. Integer outputs must agree exactly; arbitrary RGB quantization thresholds/nonfinite inputs not certified.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Color-similarity graphs and local crossing decisions are image/vectorization preprocessing components. No complete vectorizer, guaranteed planarity or visual-quality result is claimed.
scientific_intent.description: Source performs two-stage connectivity/crossing decisions. CPU-ASan on valid producer images exposes rectangular extent swaps; a real producer path exposes a non-neighbor curve transition from missingbreak; packedfield witness exposes wholeword island tests. Only those five lines are conditionally corrected. Historical Julia was constant smoke output and is archived.
scientific_intent.provenance: Original src/depixel-cuda kernel bodies andmain preserved with minimaldiff and CPUwitnesses. Corrected source matches independent graphoracle on sevenfullcases under CPU-ASan; originalsafeuniformCPUcontrol also matches. OriginalinvalidGPU inputs were neverrun.
